name: Qex
source: vpme.de QEX - Quad Drum Voice Expander - User Manual v1.10.pdf p.1 (panel image)
notes: Expander for QD (connects via rear header). CV 1 and CV 2 (marked with a clock/pulse icon) can also act as clock/trigger inputs (fills, internal decay envelopes). OUT 3/4 are either the 'car radio' rear pair or an independent PRE/POST send stereo mix, per QEX MIX setting. The four large numbered circles at the top are LED buttons, not jacks.
